articles.title: The reverse bridge: Crypto meets Wall Street using perps
articles.snippet: Crypto exchanges built perpetual futures for digital assets. Now they are using them to offer 24/7 exposure to stocks, commodities and indexes.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty shrinks 14% from this year's high as plunging revenues force operators to pivot
articles.snippet: Difficulty falls as weak mining economics reduce capacity, while forward markets signal little relief through year-end.

articles.title: How bitcoin cold wallets lost $70 million in an attack that never touched the devices
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research said weak seed generation let an attacker recreate likely private keys offline, sweep more than 1,000 BTC from nearly 1,200 wallets and continue searching without ever accessing the devices.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds monthly gain, faces 'choppy' August as 'forced-selling' exhausted, analysts say
articles.snippet: The largest crypto shrugged off a barrage of bad news this month, but traders remain cautious as rate hike fears and jobs data loom.

articles.title: Tether posts $1.5 billion operating profit in Q2 as reserve buffer falls by half
articles.snippet: The world’s largest stablecoin issuer added 14 metric tons of gold and about 1,800 bitcoin to its reserves during the second quarter.
